purpose: First SPD-00 provider/stage/traffic/full-logit evidence; no new inference optimization
license_boundary: Project-authored public prompts and measurement reports; model bytes are not redistributed. Model weights retain their upstream Llama 3.2 terms; reference/converter dependencies retain their own licenses.
source_identity_boundary: Measurements run while this implementation was being completed on the scoped parent revision. Production binary is unchanged. Final source hashes describe the published tools; 32/128 series preceded the terminal-flag guard, and all saved Ollama terminals were independently revalidated as done=true. Derivation preceded the exclusive staging wrapper; real expansion hashes/logs and synthetic filesystem race tests establish separate boundaries.
native_pid_socket_ownership: Observed ss listener on 127.0.0.1:18434 owned by PID 456665; /proc executable hash matches validated local build.
sanitization: Tool redacts native credentials and conversion source/destination paths. Copies are byte-identical to generated reports; no further payload or timing transformations. Private corpus, keys and absolute machine paths were checked absent. Added master/negative diagnostic logs mask checkout paths; their source hashes and transformations are separately listed.
boundaries: Single Linux x86-64/sm_75 GPU host, four final-prompt 3B vectors through 1070 input tokens; no broad quality claim.
Provider ordering balanced, residency loaded; current caches enabled, templates and KV precision differ, one independent session per output ceiling.
D2D bandwidth and logical bytes are a conditional reference, not profiler counters or a guaranteed maximum.
Failed setup and packed-reference comparisons preserved; tolerances unchanged.
Original CSV used uniform copy data; final authoritative CSV uses nonuniform data and full word verification.
Large raw CSVs live in local outputs; original and derived models and probe binaries stay outside Git. No publicly downloadable large-CSV archive is claimed.
